# Tiffen Central

> Authentic South Indian tiffins and cafe comforts.

A warm South Indian restaurant in Perungudi where cafe comfort meets relaxed dining. From crispy dosas and fluffy idlis to medhu vada, pongal and filter coffee, every dish is prepared fresh and rooted in Tamil Nadu's food heritage.

## Location & Contact
- **Address**: Govindasamy Nagar, Perungudi, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600096
- **Phone**: +91 91768 39842
- **Email**: tiffencentral@gmail.com
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/tiffen.central/

## Opening Hours
- Mon - Thu: 8:00 AM - 10:00 PM
- Fri - Sat: 8:00 AM - 11:30 PM
- Sunday: 9:00 AM - 9:00 PM

## Menu Summary
- **Signature Dosas**: Plain Dosa, Masala Dosa, Ghee Roast, Ghee Podi Dosa, Ghee Podi Masala Dosa, Rava Dosa, Kal Dosa
- **Benne Specials**: Benne Dosa, Benne Podi Dosa, Benne Masala Dosa, Benne Podi Masala Dosa
- **South Indian Combos**: Parota with Kurma, Chappathi with Kurma, Poori with Masala
- **Traditional Breakfast**: Ghee Pongal, Tomato Sevai
- **Vada Varieties**: Medhu Vada, Masala Vada, Sambar Vada, Curd Vada
- **Idly Corner**: Idly (Single), Idly Set, Sambar Idly, Ghee Mini Sambar Idly
- **Sweet Delight**: Pineapple Kesari
- **Beverages**: Tea, Coffee

## Key Services
- **Dine-in & Takeaway**: Traditional South Indian breakfast, snacks, tiffins & filter coffee in Perungudi, Chennai.
- **Catering Services**: Catering for private parties, corporate events, and family functions.
- **Table Booking**: Enquiries accepted via phone (+91 91768 39842) or online contact form.
